title: Machine learning identifies FXN and a CTCF-FXN axis in primary open-angle glaucoma
summary: WGCNA with LASSO regression and SVM-RFE (discovery set GSE9963) identified the oxidative stress-related gene FXN, which was down-regulated in glaucoma samples with diagnostic value. FXN fell in an H2O2 R28 cell model, and overexpression improved cell viability and reduced apoptosis and ROS; CTCF was shown by ChIP to regulate FXN. Public datasets and a cell-line model only, and diagnostic metrics were not read.
ai_technology: LASSO regression and SVM-RFE with WGCNA for candidate gene selection
organization: Second Affiliated Hospital of Xi'an Jiaotong University

evidence.tested: Other GEO datasets as validation and in vitro oxidative stress and rescue experiments in R28 cells.
evidence.unknown: Behaviour in patients or animal models; diagnostic metrics were not read.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO and SVM-RFE selected FXN from candidate oxidative-stress genes.
